title: ActionPolicy
description: The actions agents of one template may take with their tools (PRD section 8.1, FR-1004). Deny overrides allow: when any deny rule applies, the action is denied whatever else allows it, so rule order does not matter. Release 1 effects are allow, deny and monitor; requireApproval is release 2. At most one ActionPolicy applies to a template.

default.description: What happens to actions no rule allows: deny (the default) or allow. allow still yields to every deny rule.

mode.description: enforce (the default): once the gateway enforces, denied actions are blocked. monitor: they are only reported.

action.description: A tool action, for example email.send.

effect.description: allow, deny, or monitor (allow, and flag for review). requireApproval is release 2.

when.description: Request attributes that must all be true for the rule to apply. An attribute the request does not supply counts against the caller: it stops an allow or monitor rule applying, and lets a deny rule apply.

unless.description: Request attributes any one of which, when true, stops the rule applying. A missing attribute counts against the caller, as for when.
